article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Clinton Efinda had 22 points in Canisius’ 63-56 win against Mercyhurst in the Queen City Classic. on Friday. Efinda also had five rebounds for the Golden Griffins (3-3). Nate Fouts added 15 points while shooting 5 of 10 from the field and 4 for 5 from the line while they also had seven rebounds. Michael Wilson Jr. shot 2 for 12 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with nine points. Jake Lemelman led the Lakers (1-5) in scoring, finishing with 13 points. Mercyhurst also got 11 points, six rebounds and two blocks from Cameron Johnson. Deraje Agbaosi finished with 11 points and three blocks. Up next Both teams next play Saturday in the Queen City Classic. Canisius hosts Albany (NY) and Mercyhurst takes on Western Illinois. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
